title: Report the requests and commands
instructions: Write the sentences in **reported speech**. Use **tell** (command) or **ask** (request, often with *please*) + person + (**not**) **to** + infinitive.

items.direct: Mrs Moreno to Mila: "Make your bed!"
items.answer: Mrs Moreno told Mila to make her bed.

items.direct: Diego to Sofia: "Don't eat my cookies!"
items.answer: Diego told Sofia not to eat his cookies.

items.direct: Mila to Aisha: "Please send me the photos."
items.answer: Mila asked Aisha to send her the photos.

items.direct: Coach Brooks to the players: "Drink lots of water!"
items.answer: Coach Brooks told the players to drink lots of water.

items.direct: Mr Okafor to Mila: "Come back next week."
items.answer: Mr Okafor told Mila to come back [the following week|the next week|the week after].

items.direct: Mrs Patel to the students: "Please don't talk in the library."
items.answer: Mrs Patel asked the students not to talk in the library.

items.direct: Sofia to Mila: "Don't forget your umbrella!"
items.answer: Sofia told Mila not to forget her umbrella.

items.direct: Mila's dad (on the phone): "Write to your grandma!"
items.answer: Mila's dad told her to write to her grandma.

items.direct: Ms Kim to Tyler: "Please be quiet."
items.answer: Ms Kim asked Tyler to be quiet.

items.direct: Mila's mum to Mila: "Take photos of everything you see!"
items.answer: Mila's mum told her to take photos of everything she saw.
items.hint: The infinitive (*to take*) has no backshift – but the other verb does: you see → **she saw**.
